title: Crankshaft polish/grind and rotating assembly balance

notices.text: Polish journals if within spec, grind undersize only if you must (and buy matching undersize bearings). Have the full rotating assembly — crank, rods, pistons, pins, rings, bearings, and the flywheel/clutch if you want it perfect — balanced as a set. This is the difference between a rebuilt engine and a built one, and on a flat-six it is felt directly in how the engine revs.
